sf-lagna.note: Right and personal. A Russian word ("ярьж") in the first sentence.

sf-dasha.note: Neither good nor bad, right dates, what helps. House numbers ("11 වැනි භාවය").

sf-abroad.note: Right, no promise. Leaves out Jupiter.

sf-rajju.note: Calms the parents, honest, next step. A little heavy on rules.

sf-erashtaka.note: Explains it, right dates. A slip ("මීනට").

sf-poruwa.note: Natural and in order; leaves out the right foot.

sf-avurudu.note: Every time, each with what the family does, simple enough for children.

sf-sad.note: Warm first, a real strength, asks what was said.

sf-formal.note: Matches the formal question and speaks of the daughter.

sf-singlish.note: Sinhala script, useful for the decision. Some translated words ("වැඩ-ජීවිත සමතුලිතතාව").

sf-ch-love.note: Right, with later dates. "ප්‍රදේශය" for a part of the chart sounds translated.

sf-ch-periods.note: All dates exact. A broken word with Russian letters ("ඉලээным").
